title: Synchronize the Tenant Database with the Application Database

facts.text: Synchronize tenant database schema with application database for single-tenant or multitenant deployments.
Two methods available: use Dynamics NAV development environment or Sync-NAVTenant PowerShell cmdlet.
Development environment method applies to Spring 2019 and earlier versions only.
Open development environment as administrator, choose Tools menu, select Sync. Schema For All Tables.
Run admin shell on server computer as administrator and execute Sync-NAVTenant cmdlet with ServerInstance parameter.
For multitenant instance, include both ServerInstance and Tenant parameters in the cmdlet.
